queries.query: Implement a responsive settings surface in our existing React admin app. Use the current component library and design tokens, and cover keyboard access, async loading, empty and error outcomes, a disabled Save state, and a safe Delete account flow.

Build a command palette for our existing Electron desktop interface using the app's components and tokens. It must support keyboard navigation, adaptive sizing, and explicit loading, no-results, error, and selected states.
Review the supplied desktop and mobile dashboard screenshots, identify spacing, hierarchy, contrast, and overflow regressions, and return prioritized findings. Do not change the implementation.

Before implementation begins, develop three contrasting visual directions for a personal-finance dashboard, with type, color, density, and composition rationale. We are deciding on a direction and do not want code yet.
